import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def one_req(wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external", t=0, raw=False):
    hexs = wire if raw else h(wire)
    return envelope([ev(t, peer, auth, eg, hexs)])

def reason_of(wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external", raw=False):
    rc, out, err = run(one_req(wire, peer, auth, eg, raw))
    if rc != 0:
        return ("EXIT", rc)
    r = json.loads(out)
    return r["results"][0].get("reason", r["results"][0]["decision"])

def expect_reason(name, wire, want, raw=False, **kw):
    got = reason_of(wire, raw=raw, **kw)
    expect(name, got == want, f"want={want} got={got}")
